WHAT WE ARRANGE FOR YOU

Start-up builds on the actual condition.

We commission equipment we have supplied and, depending on the specific technology, treatment plants from other manufacturers too.

Installation and connections

Checking that the installation and technological connections are correct and that the components work.

Controls and the biological process

Setting up the control unit and operating parameters, and checking the treatment process.

Start-up and handover

Putting the plant into operation, the commissioning report and handover to the customer.

EQUIPMENT HANDOVER

A report. And clear next steps.

Commissioning includes a report and handover to the customer. If you also need practical operator training, we will agree its scope together.

A CLEAR SEQUENCE OF STEPS

What professional commissioning includes.

The scope of the checks and settings depends on the specific technology.

  1. 01

    Installation check

    Verifying the installation and the way the equipment is connected up.

  2. 02

    Component check

    Checking that the individual parts of the technology work.

  3. 03

    Control settings

    Setting up the control units and operating parameters.

  4. 04

    Biological process

    Checking and adjusting the biological treatment process.

  5. 05

    Start-up

    Starting up the equipment within the agreed scope.

  6. 06

    Report and handover

    Preparing a commissioning report and handing over to the customer.

BEFORE YOU GET IN TOUCH

What you may want to know.

Do you have a specific installation or brief? Let's go through it together.

+420 736 403 795
Will you commission a treatment plant I bought elsewhere?+

Depending on the specific technology, yes. We also provide this service for treatment plants from other manufacturers. Send us the type and manufacturer of the equipment and information about the current state of the installation.

What will I receive at handover?+

The service includes preparing a commissioning report and handing the equipment over to the customer.

Can operator training follow on?+

Yes. We offer practical training right where the plant is installed, covering the technology as well as regular checks and maintenance. Just mention it in your enquiry.

LET'S DISCUSS YOUR BRIEF

Is your treatment plant ready to start up?

Tell us the manufacturer and type of the WWTP, where it is installed and its current state. We will discuss the options for commissioning that particular technology.
